name: Base44
verdict: A full-stack vibe coder with a real free tier; paid plans on the page are the annual rates, starting at $16 a month.
pros: Free plan includes auth, database, and up to 5 apps
You can export the code to GitHub
cons: Message credits run out on bigger builds
The page did not show the month-to-month prices
pricingNote: Every paid price above is the annual rate shown on the pricing page. The FAQ says annual billing saves 20%, but the month-to-month amounts were not displayed.
